## Dependency Management

```{r}

renv::restore()

#list of used packages
library(jsonlite)
library(markdown)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
```

## Preparing dataframe for inserting coder data

```{r}

# Extracting variable names from json file

data_coder01 <- fromJSON("backup_CODER01_2026-08-06.json") %>% .$records %>%
  select(-c(paper_title, meta_id, meta_year, meta_authors, meta_title, meta_journal, meta_doi, meta_reproducer))
data_coder03 <- fromJSON("backup_Coder03_2026-07-30.json") %>% .$records %>%
  select(-c(paper_title, meta_id, meta_year, meta_authors, meta_title, meta_journal, meta_doi, meta_reproducer))
data_coder04 <- fromJSON("backup_Coder04_2026-07-27.json") %>% .$records %>%
  select(-c(paper_title, meta_id, meta_year, meta_authors, meta_title, meta_journal, meta_doi, meta_reproducer))

```

## Rename variables

```{r}

# suffix each coder's columns
c1 <- data_coder01 %>% rename_with(~paste0(., "_c1"), -paper_id)
c3 <- data_coder03 %>% rename_with(~paste0(., "_c3"), -paper_id)
c4 <- data_coder04 %>% rename_with(~paste0(., "_c4"), -paper_id)

# Combine into one dataframe
combined <- list(c1, c3, c4) %>% reduce(full_join, by = "paper_id")

# Variables to compare
var_compare <- c("q4_source_0", "q4_link_0",
  "q5_other_text", "itr_value", "itr_page",
  "itr_table_num", "itr_supp_link", "general_notes",
  "q1_yes", "q1_no", "q2_yes",
  "q2_no", "q_readme_yes", "q_readme_no",
  "q_readme_unsure", "q3_ps", "q3_ci",
  "q3_un", "q5_r", "q5_python",
  "q5_matlab", "q5_stata", "q5_julia",
  "q5_spss", "q5_mplus", "q5_c_cpp",
  "q5_shell", "q5_unclear", "q5_other",
  "q6_not_mentioned", "q6_broken", "q6_empty",
  "q6_request", "q6_restricted", "q6_other",
  "q_itr_main_yes", "q_itr_main_no", "q_itr_supp_yes",
  "q_itr_supp_no"
)

# Agreement variable per variable to compare
for (v in var_compare) {
  cols <- paste0(v, c("_c1", "_c3", "_c4"))
  combined[[paste0(v, "_agreement")]] <- apply(combined[cols], 1, function(x) length(unique(x)) == 1)
}

# reorder: id, then var1_c1/c2/c3/agreement, var2_c1/c2/c3/agreement, ...
ordered_cols <- c("paper_id", unlist(lapply(var_compare, function(v) 
  c(paste0(v, c("_c1", "_c3", "_c4")), paste0(v, "_agreement"))
)))

combined <- combined %>% select(all_of(ordered_cols))


```
